title: Joomla capture --whole-units keeps a sentence with a linked word as separate text slots, so a write never empties the link
steps: S1: From the repo root at the commit under test, with php on PATH: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/cms/tracy-joomla-quickstart/test/capture-contract.test.mjs

S2: Read the result lines of the tests whose names start with 'C1: a sentence with a link keeps its pieces apart' (LINK), 'C1: text inside an element with a title or alt of its own' (TITLE), 'C1: a heading cut by a span and a br is still one slot' (SPAN) and 'C1: a list item with an icon and cut text is still one slot' (ICON).
expect: LINK, TITLE, SPAN and ICON are each 'ok' (before the fix: LINK and TITLE failed, the paragraph was merged into one slot on /html/body/div/p, which the plugin writes as a link with no words).

fence: packages/cms/tracy-joomla-quickstart/scripts/capture-contract.py: whole_units skips a unit with a piece inside an element carrying an href/src/alt/title slot, and no longer counts attribute slots as text pieces.

tests: C1: a sentence with a link keeps its pieces apart, so writing it never empties the link
C1: text inside an element with a title or alt of its own also keeps the unit apart
C1: a heading cut by a span and a br is still one slot
C1: a list item with an icon and cut text is still one slot
